expectations.text: Identifies that standard VI / the ELBO minimizes reverse KL, i.e. KL(q||p).
expectations.evidence: Explicitly states ELBO = minimizing KL(q‖p) = reverse KL.

expectations.text: Explains reverse KL is mode-seeking / zero-forcing and therefore underestimates variance — the narrow intervals are expected, not a tuning bug.
expectations.evidence: States reverse KL is mode-seeking/zero-forcing; explains optimizer locks onto one mode and is systematically too narrow. Frames this as expected, not a bug.

expectations.text: Contrasts with forward KL KL(p||q) being mass-covering / variance-respecting.
expectations.evidence: Explicitly contrasts forward KL (mass-covering, used by EP and MCMC) with reverse KL (mode-seeking, used by VI).
